reason: I'm not putting a bot in my crew's work chat and handing it a Google sign-in. Even setting that aside, half my site receipts are faded or handwritten nota, and I'd bet I end up checking every row myself anyway.
objection: A bot reading every message in my work group and getting into my Google account. Then it misreads a smudged Indonesian nota, and I'm the one cleaning up the sheet before the accountant sees it.
would_change_my_mind: Let me forward receipts privately with no Google login, just a file it sends back. And show me it reading a stack of my own faded handwritten notas correctly before I pay anything.
